title: Book Three · Chapter 90: Two Yuan Each
story:
On Friday, Ronan and Leo spread the eighteen books across the table.

The first sale is tomorrow morning. The price card is still blank.

“Two yuan each,” Leo says.

“All of them?”

“They are ordinary used books. One clear price is easier.”

Ronan picks up his yellow puzzle book. There is a pencil answer on the last page.

“This one has writing.”

“Then show the page.”

Leo opens his railway stories. A name is written inside the cover. He leaves it visible.

Ronan writes Used Books at the top of the card. Below it, he puts Two Yuan Each. He uses large, clear letters.

They test the two rows on the folded cloth. The three R books are at one end, the three L books beside them. The twelve bought books fill the other row.

The little source marks stay inside the back covers. The price is the same for every book.

Anna comes through the green door with her notebook. Mum greets her from the window and gives her a chair near Ronan.

She has news from the art centre.

“Both places are confirmed. The third Saturday, nine at the main library.”

Ronan smiles. “I have it written down.”

He shows her the page. Leave at half past eight is beside her visit.

Leo points to his own name under the table time.

“I'll be here.”

Anna nods. “Good. I want to take my drawings. The guide says we can ask about the plans.”

She opens one page and shows Ronan a doorway she wants to understand better. He looks at it with her for a little while.

Then she needs to leave. Lin is waiting at the library for their afternoon maths work.

“Good luck tomorrow,” Anna says.

“You can come and buy all eighteen,” Leo tells her.

She laughs. “My bag is already full.”

Ronan walks her to the gate. She takes his hand briefly before she goes.

“Next Saturday,” she says.

“At the library.”

He watches her turn the corner, then returns to the price card.

Leo has one of the bought travel books open. There are bright pictures near the middle.

“This will go,” he says.

“Someone needs to want it.”

“Then put it where they can see it.”

They move that book to the front of its row. Ronan puts the cash sheet in the shared envelope. He keeps his ten personal yuan apart, with money for the visit's bus fare.

At the end of the table, his blue bracelet catches against a book corner. He frees it gently, closes the book, and puts the first bag ready beside the door.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

price card＝价牌；visible＝看得见的；confirm＝确认；luck＝运气。

## 理解问题

1. 所有书定价多少？旧书里的笔迹和原主姓名有没有被当作不存在？
2. Anna确认了什么重要安排？她为什么不能一直留下来帮卖书？

## 读句子

**The price is the same for every book.**

拆开看：The price / is the same / for every book.

价格／都一样／每本书都是这个价。
